race.comment: NATURE BOY (3) flew the lids off the inside draw with a fast early split last time and went on to clock 17.46 when a 2.5 lengths winner over 300m at this track. Comes out of a solid form race last start. Can measure up again. REDEEM A ARCADIA (2) was last seen getting around 300m at this track in a swift 17.41 for a 3.5 lengths win. Has the ability and looks a key chance. SHE'S SILKY (6) broke well and quickly mustered speed to win over the 300m at this track two runs back then settled forward again when finishing third at this track last start. Bold showing expected. BEAUTIFUL BANTER (1) should bounce back after an unplaced effort here recently.
